privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Zarati is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
privacy.collectBody: When you join our waitlist we collect your full name, email address, professional role (farmer, trader, NGO, government, or investor), and preferred language. We do not collect payment information, precise location data, or any sensitive personal data at this stage.
privacy.useBody: Your data is used to notify you when Zarati launches, send relevant platform updates, and understand our user base to improve the product. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.storageBody: Your data is stored securely using Supabase, a GDPR-compliant cloud infrastructure provider. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We retain waitlist data until you request deletion or until the platform launches and you create an account.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise any of these rights, email us at the address below and we will respond within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing Zarati or joining our waitlist you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
terms.statusBody: Zarati is currently in pre-launch phase. All market data, listings, and statistics displayed on the platform are for demonstration purposes only and do not represent real transactions, prices, or recommendations.
terms.useBody: You agree to use Zarati only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. You must not misuse the platform, attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the service, or submit false or misleading information.
terms.ipBody: All content, branding, and technology on Zarati is owned by or licensed to Zarati. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from any part of the platform without prior written permission.
terms.disclaimerBody: Zarati is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the accuracy of any data displayed. We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the platform.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Sudan. Any disputes arising from these terms or your use of the platform shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Sudanese courts.
